step1_analysis.description: The circuit consists of a cascode amplifier (XM1, XM2) followed by a source follower buffer (XM4, XM3). It forms the active core of an ultra-wideband LNA, designed to be used with resistive shunt-feedback and inductive peaking for wideband matching and flat gain.

paper_reference.title: An Ultra-Wideband CMOS Low Noise Amplifier for 3–5-GHz UWB System

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the circuit.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The provided netlist uses very small transistors (W=5u) compared to a typical LNA, resulting in much lower power consumption than the paper's optimized design.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm1 = 2*Id1/Vov = 1.29mS. With a 2kOhm load resistor added in the testbench, core gain = 2.58 V/V. Source follower gain ~ 0.8 V/V. Total gain = 2.06 V/V = 6.2 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load resistor added in the testbench, as the original inductive load is not present in the netlist.

bandwidth_3db.description: Frequency at which the gain drops by 3 dB from its maximum.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3db = 1 / (2 * pi * R_load * C_par). With R_load=2k and C_par~30fF at the cascode drain, f_3db ~ 2.6 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is limited by the RC time constant at the cascode drain node in this testbench setup, lacking the inductive peaking used in the paper.

sky130_expected.calculation: NF is typically dominated by the input transistor gm and channel noise.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Without the proper input matching network and optimal sizing, NF will be higher than the paper's optimized design.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC voltage gain, 3-dB bandwidth, and transient output swing of the LNA core.
step3_testbench.spice:
* UWB LNA Core Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

* DUT
XM2 N0 VDD N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N6 VB2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VDD N0 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM1 N3 N4 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

* Biasing and Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB2 VB2 0 0.54
VIN N4 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.01 100MEG 0 0)
VN5 N5 0 0
RL N0 VDD 2k
CL N6 0 50f

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 50 1Meg 100G
  let gain_db = vdb(N6)
  meas ac max_gain MAX gain_db
  meas ac f_3db when gain_db='max_gain - 3' fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 100p 50n
  meas tran v_out_max MAX v(N6)
  meas tran v_out_min MIN v(N6)
  let v_out_pp = v_out_max - v_out_min
  print v_out_pp
  
  quit
.endc
.end
